notes.title: Discover Old D'Hanis Open House
notes.content:
[p]🌟 Join us for an exclusive Open House to experience [i]Discover Old D'Hanis[/i]! 🏛️[/p][p][/p][p]Explore the virtual archaeology game crafted from meticulous archaeological, archival, and historical research in D'Hanis, Texas.[/p][p][/p][p]📅 [b]Date:[/b] Friday, June 13th, 2025[/p][p]🕓 [b]Time:[/b] Drop in anytime between 4:00 PM - 7:00 PM[/p][p]📍 [b]Location:[/b] D'Hanis Community Centre[/p][p]🏠 7475 Co Rd 524, D'Hanis, TX 78850, United States[/p][p][/p][p][b]What to Expect:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Play-test the immersive archaeology adventure.[/p][/*][*][p]Gain insights into the latest updates and development progress.[/p][/*][*][p]Learn about the archaeological process and the making of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Share your feedback to help us enhance your experience.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Hosted by:[/b]
Dr. Trish Markert, Assistant Professor of Anthropology at Western University, and lead game developer Michael Salton.[/p]

notes.title: Mac Support Added
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that Discover Old D'Hanis is now available on macOS!
You can now experience the rich history and unique atmosphere of D'Hanis on your Mac.

🗺️ Roam through the historic landscapes
📜 Uncover the town's hidden stories
📷 Enjoy the visuals on your favorite Apple device

Thank you for your continued support—this is a big step in making Discover Old D'Hanis accessible to more explorers!

👉 Available now on both Windows and macOS via Steam.

Come and explore D'Hanis with us!
